info.title: metalama
info.description: A Metalama command line tool. Used for registering a license key or accessing some configuration settings.

commands.name: cleanup
commands.description: Removes temporary files and cache generated by Metalama

options.name: --all
options.description:
Deletes all directories and files ignoring clean-up
policies

options.name: --no-kill
options.description: Does not kill processes before clean-up

commands.name: config
commands.description: Manages Metalama configuration settings

commands.name: dump
commands.description:
Writes every configuration, or one of them, to the console as a single JSON
document

options.name: --all
options.description:
Dumps every configuration. This is also what happens when
no alias is given

arguments.name: ALIAS
arguments.description:
The alias of a single configuration to dump. Dumps every
configuration when omitted

commands.name: edit
commands.description: Opens a JSON configuration file in the default text editor

arguments.name: ALIAS
arguments.description:
The alias of the configuration file. Use the 'configuration list'
command to list available configuration files

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists all supported JSON configuration files

commands.name: print
commands.description: Displays the contents of a configuration file in the console

arguments.name: ALIAS
arguments.description:
The alias of the configuration file. Use the 'configuration list'
command to list available configuration files

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Resets a configuration file to its default values

arguments.name: ALIAS
arguments.description:
The alias of the configuration file. Use the 'configuration list'
command to list available configuration files

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validates a configuration file against its schema

arguments.name: ALIAS
arguments.description:
The alias of the configuration file. Use the 'configuration list'
command to list available configuration files

commands.name: divorce
commands.description:
Copies code generated by Metalama back into your source code, in case you wanted
to stop using Metalama

options.name: --force
options.description:
Force the divorce feature, even if the working directory is
not known to be clean

commands.name: docs
commands.description: Opens the Metalama documentation in your browser

commands.name: introspect
commands.description:
Queries how Metalama applied aspects to a project, from the files of its last
build. Never builds

commands.name: batch
commands.description:
Runs several queries, one per line of the standard input or of --file, over one
load of the files. Each line is a command without 'introspect', such as 'show
declaration src/Customer.cs:18'

options.name: --where
options.description:
A condition in the OData
$filter syntax, such as
"aspectClass/shortName eq
'Log'". Several are
combined with 'and'. The
functions are contains,
startswith, endswith,
matchesPattern, indexof,
length, substring, concat,
tolower, toupper and trim.
Quote it with single
quotes in a shell that
expands $ inside double
quotes, or escape the $ of
$count. See 'introspect
schema' for the fields

options.name: --select
options.description:
The fields to write,
separated by commas, such
as
id,aspectClass/shortName,t
ransformations/$count

options.name: --order-by
options.description:
The order in the OData
$orderby syntax:
expressions separated by
commas, each followed by
asc or desc, such as
"targetDeclaration/id
desc"
the result
of objects. By default
100, except with --format
jsonl. The output says
when the result is
truncated

options.name: --skip
options.description:
Skips the first objects of
the result

options.name: --limit
options.description:
Writes at most this number
of objects. By default
100, except with --format
jsonl. The output says
when the result is
truncated

options.name: --all
options.description:
Writes every object,
without the default limit

options.name: --count
options.description:
Writes only the number of
objects that satisfy the
conditions

arguments.description:
The object: a source position (src/Customer.cs:42), a C#
name without parameters, possibly partial

documentation comment identifier
('M:App.Repository.Get(System.Int32)'). Quote it when it is
not plain

commands.name: license
commands.description: Manages license keys and switch between Metalama editions

commands.name: acquire-lease
commands.description:
Acquires a lease from the registered license server and prints the license it
leases

options.name: --force
options.description:
Renews the lease even when the one currently held is still
valid and not yet due for renewal

commands.name: community
commands.description:
Switches to the Metalama Community edition, which is free and must be renewed
every year

options.name: --reason
options.description:
The reason for which you are entitled to the
edition: Individual, NonCommercial, OpenSource or
SmallBusiness. Use it for a scripted install. When
it is omitted, the command asks for the reason

commands.name: free
commands.description: Registers the Metalama Free license (for Metalama 2025.0 and earlier)

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists all registered licenses

commands.name: register
commands.description:
Registers a new license key or license server URL. To register an edition that
requires no license key, use 'license community' or 'license free' or 'license
try'

arguments.name: LICENSE
arguments.description: The license key or license server URL to be registered

commands.name: try
commands.description: Activates the Metalama Professional trial period

commands.name: unregister
commands.description: Unregisters all license keys and license servers

commands.name: news
commands.description: Manages toast notifications for new Metalama updates

commands.name: disable
commands.description: Disables automatic notifications for new Metalama updates

commands.name: enable
commands.description: Enables automatic notifications for new Metalama updates

commands.name: notify
commands.description: Displays a notification with the latest Metalama news

commands.name: status
commands.description: Displays the current news notification settings

commands.name: preview
commands.description:
Shows the code that Metalama generates for some files of a project, formatted,
without building the project

options.name: --project
options.description:
The project file. By default, the nearest project
file in the directory of the first file or above

options.name: --framework
options.description:
The target framework. By default, the first target
framework of the project

options.name: --configuration
options.description:
The build configuration. By default, the default
configuration of the project

options.name: --output
options.description:
A directory where the transformed files are written.
By default, they are written to the standard output

options.name: --no-restore
options.description:
Do not restore the project before reading its
compiler command line

arguments.name: FILES
arguments.description:
The C# files whose transformed code is shown. All must belong to
the same project

commands.name: shutdown
commands.description:
Stops the processes that keep Metalama files locked after a build: asks them to
exit, waits for them, and reports the ones that remain. Also available as 'kill'

options.name: --no-warn
options.description:
Does not report any warnings
ends the ones that have not exited
when the timeout has elapsed

options.name: --force
options.description:
Cancels the work of the processes, and
ends the ones that have not exited
when the timeout has elapsed

options.name: --all
options.description:
Also ends the processes that are left
running by default, such as those of
integrated development environments

options.name: --timeout
options.description:
60         How long to wait for the processes to
exit, in seconds

commands.name: telemetry
commands.description: Manages telemetry settings and upload queued data

commands.name: disable
commands.description: Disables telemetry for a scenario (usage, exception, performance or all)

arguments.name: SCENARIO
arguments.description:
The kind of telemetry to configure: 'usage', 'exception',
'performance' or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'

commands.name: enable
commands.description: Enables telemetry for a scenario (usage, exception, performance or all)

arguments.name: SCENARIO
arguments.description:
The kind of telemetry to configure: 'usage', 'exception',
'performance' or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'

commands.name: reset
commands.description:
Resets telemetry for a scenario (usage, exception, performance or all) to its
default state (review-first for exceptions and performance problems)

arguments.name: SCENARIO
arguments.description:
The kind of telemetry to configure: 'usage', 'exception',
'performance' or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'

commands.name: reset-dedup
commands.description:
Clears the record of already-reported issues so they are captured again (testing
aid)

commands.name: reset-device-id
commands.description: Generates a new anonymous device identifier for telemetry

commands.name: status
commands.description: Displays current telemetry configuration and status

commands.name: upload
commands.description: Uploads all queued telemetry data immediately

options.name: --async
options.description: Run the upload asynchronously in a background process

options.name: --force
options.description:
Force the upload even if another upload has been performed
recently

commands.name: ui
commands.description: Opens the browser-based configuration interface

commands.name: version
commands.description: Prints version information
